_what: Every artifact or log a SHIPPED capability tells someone to write, and whether BOSS — its own first project — actually has one.
_why: BOSS ships 9 record types and 5 machine logs. A 2026-08-20 audit found its own repo exercises 4 record types and 0 logs. FEAT-022 declared the venture brain 'complete' at v0.65.0 and BOSS has never written one. /extract encodes PRINCIPLE #1 — BOSS's FIRST principle — and has produced zero records in 156 releases. The disease is the one this whole arc is about: BOSS instructs, and nothing verifies the instruction was followed. A capability nobody has ever run is not shipped, it is published.

_verdicts.exercised: BOSS's own repo has one. The capability has been run for real at least once.
_verdicts.exempt: Legitimately not applicable to BOSS, with the reason written down. Most are for a FOUNDER'S APP — BOSS is a zero-dep CLI with no users, no signup funnel and no LLM in the product.
_verdicts.owed: Applies to BOSS, and BOSS has never done it. A real gap, named rather than hidden. Does NOT fail the gate — a gate that is red forever is a gate you bypass, and a bypassed gate is a dead one. It is counted and printed every release until someone acts.

_enforced_by: npm run check:dogfood — in `npm test` and the release gate. UNCLASSIFIED fails. A new artifact-writing capability cannot ship without someone deciding which of the three it is.

artifacts.why: Root cause fixed 2026-08-20 (the conscience hook had never been installed here), and the DEPENDENCE is now fixed too: `deriveBrainFacts` gives the conscience a factual floor from the records and the frequency ledger, so a skipped /close no longer means no memory. This file stays owed on purpose — it holds the POV, and a POV is the one thing that cannot be derived. It is written by a person at the end of a real session.

artifacts.capability: the venture brain — what the conscience said and what the founder did
artifacts.why: Same root cause and same fix as read.md. This one additionally requires the conscience to have FIRED during a session and the founder to have responded, which is now possible for the first time — it was not, before 2026-08-20. Fabricating entries about nudges that never happened would be the exact dishonesty this ledger exists to prevent.

RESET 2026-08-21 — the file exists and the hook is wired, but it is EMPTY and its history is gone: an assistant ran `boss remove --apply` from this directory by mistake and .boss/ is gitignored, so nothing could restore it. It had been populating since 2026-08-20, when the conscience hook was installed into BOSS own repo for the first time. THE ORIGINAL ROOT CAUSE is still worth keeping: it was never "nobody ran it" — BOSS .claude/ had no hooks directory and no `hooks` block in settings.json, and .boss/manifest.json was pinned at bossVersion 0.6.0, 180 releases stale. The conscience had never fired on the project building it. Frequency data restarts from 2026-08-21; do not read this log as continuous.

Written by the `auto-log` hook, which `check:manifests` lists as DORMANT BY DESIGN — unregistered on purpose in the shipped manifests. So this is not the same failure as the others: the substrate is deliberately off, and /judge-traces has therefore never had real input anywhere, including in a founder's project. That is worth its own decision (turn it on for BOSS, or admit /judge-traces is unproven), not a silent 'owed'.

Substituted, not skipped: registry/CHANGELOG.md is the per-version record and docs/RESUME.md is the session state. Both are richer than a devlog and both are actually maintained. Naming the substitute is the point — an unexplained absence and a deliberate one look identical from outside.
The terminal read and .boss/board.html are both exercised constantly. The markdown projection is an output format, not a separate discipline.

Records `npm run release` — 22 checks, 181 unit tests, a 152-case eval gate. Previously marked exempt on the grounds that BOSS was 'well past' rung 1. That reasoning was wrong in an instructive way: verification-loop fired correctly the moment the conscience was installed, and its own first branch says so — 'if they already have verification under another name, the gap is BOSS's blindness, not their discipline.' The honest fix was to record the command, not to exempt the artifact.

BOSS is a zero-dependency CLI that never calls a model. There is no per-call spend to log. The conscience runs inside the founder's own Claude session, on their subscription — which is why IDEA-013 reframed BOSS's own version from cost to FREQUENCY in the first place.
For a founder's AI product. BOSS has no LLM in the product.
For a founder's AI product — the five failure modes are UX states in an app with users.
For a founder's AI product. No model calls, no budget.
BOSS has no database. Machine state is JSON on disk by rule (CLAUDE.md #4). Was `db-architect (L2)` until v0.189.0 retired the agent (DEC-005); the exemption reason is unchanged by that.
For a founder's app funnel. BOSS's activation question is a real founder running `boss new`, and its honest answer is EVID-001 — a person, not a metric.
Same as activation.md — signup-to-aha is a product-with-users concept.
Scale-mode artifact. BOSS is at MVP and the V1→Scale rung is deliberately trigger-gated (IDEA-040).

Run for the first time at v0.187.0. BOSS is not a component app, so it catalogs what BOSS actually has: 108 tokens in 25 groups, 8 CSS class families across three real surfaces, with content hashes. It caught one genuine drift on its first run — a hardcoded #16181A in the board's hi-vis chip, now `--ink-on-hivis`. It also caught a false positive in its own detector (`--stage-0` has a digit, so a `[a-z-]+` name pattern missed it and flagged a token definition as raw drift).
Aimed at a founder's app UI. BOSS's user surface is a CLI and a static site; the site is covered by check:site, which is a stricter and automated equivalent.
BOSS's own docs/loops/ is the gitignored dogfood workspace and carries the loops it actually runs. The MVP loop set ships in stages/L1-mvp/template/ and is exercised by every scaffold test.

PRAC-NNN is a craft learning shared with a COFOUNDER. BOSS is solo by construction, and the same learnings go UP into library/practices/ (31 of them) via /boss-learn, which is the richer path. If BOSS ever has a second builder this flips to owed.

EXTR-001 (derive-don't-stamp) and EXTR-002 (agreement is not truth) written 2026-08-20, 156 releases late. Both route UP, both name what did NOT make the cut — `proof:` and `program:` are held at NOT-YET on n=1, because promoting a one-week-old convention into library/ on a single repo's evidence is how the shelf fills with things nobody validated.

Unlocks at Scale, and Scale's own rung is deliberately trigger-gated (IDEA-040) on a real project hitting a coordination symptom. BOSS is one person at MVP; an RFC process here would be the premature ceremony BOSS exists to refuse.
Unlocks at Scale. BOSS runs experiments as evals and /vet verdicts (152 eval cases, 82 RVW records) rather than as EXP files — the substitute is exercised heavily and the original would duplicate it.
